verdict.rationale: Automation is a fair question for remote-access and IT-support tools, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no feature for defining automations, scheduled tasks, or autonomous background workflows. Unattended access with a permanent password and the Server Pro management API are adjacent: one is an access mode and the other a developer building block, so neither counts as an automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
